user.title: Xiaomi MIoT Camera Setup
user.description:
Click submit to start setting up your Xiaomi cameras.

Note: This integration requires the 'Xiaomi Camera Proxy' add-on to be installed and running.

auth.title: Xiaomi Account Login
auth.description:
Please authenticate with your Xiaomi account:

**Step 1:** Click the link below to open Xiaomi login page:
[Open Login Page]({auth_url})

**Step 2:** Log in with your Xiaomi account and authorize.

**Step 3:** After successful authorization, the page will display the authorization info. Copy the **code** and **state** values from the URL or page.

**Step 4:** Paste the code and state below, then click Submit.

cameras.title: Select Cameras
